en: Black‑and‑white street view showing an old town commercial street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings with shops on the ground floors. People walk along the sidewalks, some with children, and several 1930s‑era cars are parked on the street. Signs in Swedish hang above the shops. At the bottom left, white text reads "Söderhamn. Köpmangatan." and at the bottom right is a photographer/publisher imprint "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI Foto & Ensamrätt: A/B Almquist & Cöster, Hälsingborg."
